steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine flour, baking soda, salt, and baking powder in a medium bowl.

Beat shortening, white sugar, and brown sugar together in a large bowl with an electric mixer until smooth. Beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mix in flour mixture until just incorporated; fold in white chocolate chips, blueberries, and cranberries until evenly combined.
Roll dough into walnut-sized balls; place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Flatten each ball to about ½-inch thick.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on the baking sheets for 10 minutes before transferring to wire racks to cool completely.

raw_recipe.headline: Independence Day Cookies
raw_recipe.description: This cookie recipe includes dried blueberries, cranberries, and white chocolate chips to make your next Independence Day party a fun, festive event.

review.reviewBody: Thanks for this recipe! I added a few things into it, like 1/2 tsp of Vanilla extract and 1/2 tsp of Almond extract, just to give it a little more zing to the flavor. Oh, I also added some macadamia nuts into the batch, and it came out Marvelous! Two thumbs up!

I gave these 4 stars because I made two changes. I know, I hate when people do that too. Instead of shortening, I used butter and added a tsp. of almond extract. If I make it again, I will reduce the almond extract to 1/2 tsp and add 1/2 tsp of vanilla as per Blufoxie's suggestion. My son who hates dried fruit LOVED these cookies and ate 6 of them in one sitting. I too thought they were very good. Can't wait to find out what the rest of the family thinks of them at the 4th of July picnic.

Very good!! From having used my grandma's recipe for years and years that everyone absolutely LOVES, and knowing the ratio of ingredients in it, I actually used margarine, and I only used 3 sticks (1 1/2 cups) of it instead of 4 sticks; I also used 1 TBSP vanilla--who makes cookies without vanilla?! Also, I felt that the amount of fruit and white chips in it was going to be way too much, so I used the whole 12 ounces of white chips, but then only used about 3/4 cup each of the blueberries and cranberries. They're delicious!!

Scrumptious! Just might have wanted a bit more dough or a little less of the additions. First time I use a recipe I always try to do it as written but I only had fresh blueberries and decided to go for it. Actually turned out quite nicely the gooey cranberry with the juicy blueberry, yum. Also after reading a few reviews decided to add a teaspoon of vanilla since it usually enhances the flavors. Would make it this way again.

I just made these cookies last night for my familly's oath of citizenship celebratrion and to take to work to share my joy there as well! It was difficult to find dried blueberries, I don't shop at the right stores apparently, so I used blueberry juice infused cranberries (store-bought). The color pattern was not red-white- blue like I anticipated. For my cookies the color scheme looked like a typical golden brown of a sugar cookie wiht the dark read of the cranberries coming through... the white chocolate was kinda small to see. I did add the 1/2 tsp of vanilla as suggested before. Overall the coookies tasted great!! The juice from berries kept the cookies very moist and aromatic. The dough was easy to handle and I even mixed it my hand. The cookies once cooled just slide off the cookie sheets. The cookies are very filling and tasty. The cookie consistency was kind of flakey which made for an interesting texture contrast compared to the fruit not like a typical hard shortbread cookie. I don't have much experience baking, as this was only my 4th batch and 4th recipe to try, but I would make these again.

As written there is just too much “stuff” and not enough cookie. I made them exactly as written first try and the flavor is great. I cannot imagine adding vanilla or other extracts as others have and it not being over the top. When I make these again I’ll use an ounce or 2 less of each of the berries and the chips (the proportion of 1:1:1 is perfect- there is just too much everything making them difficult to work with and keep together.).
This cookie recipe was the best! I modified the recipe slightly after reading the reviews. I used 1 cup of butter and 1 cup of crisco and added 1 tsp of vanilla and they came out great!

The husband and I LOVED these. Used 1/2 butter and 1/2 shortening (since I didn't have butter-flavored shortening, I added 1/4 t. of butter flavoring), and I added 1 t. vanilla. The cookies came out moist and delicious--more people need to find this recipe!
Wonderful recipe! The only adjustment I had to make was an additional egg (total of 3 eggs), as my dough was very powdery and dry at the bottom of my mixing bowl.
Just finished making these, i also added 1/2 a tsp of Vanilla and Almond extract and used what i had on hand, Cranberries Raisins and Walnuts, everyone loves them including me, Thanks.

Only made 1/2 a batch and then used 1/2 butter and 1/2 shortening. The colors are great for any patriotic holiday. I made these for Memorial Day and they were a huge hit at the party. The did flatten out a little bit as they baked, but that may have been because of the butter that I used.
I added one package of vanilla pudding mix.
Just made these cookies for our cookout tomorrow. They are delish. I made it just like the recipe. thanks.
Added a little more salt. 2 teaspoons
These are delicious! I did cut back on the sugar and used dried cherries instead of cranberries.
I only made a half a batch! It made over 5 dozen cookies. They were delicious! I made them for book club and the ladies loved them!
These are a good basic cookie recipe. I added vanilla because I like the flavor it gives the cookies.
Definitely a nice twist on chocolate chip cookies. Will make these again for sure!
Here in Europe we call these French biscuits LOVE them.

I made the cookies exactly according to the recipe. The cookies have a very soft texture but are far too sweet for my tatse. I would make them again, but reduce the amounts of both sugars and white chocolate chip chips. Otherwise, the blend of cranberries, white chocoalte and blueberries is a very nice flavor combination.
